lines.en: I follow you without missing a step.

lines.zh: 我的深红鳞片在光下发亮
lines.en: My amaranth scales catch the light.
I walk at your rear flank.
My wings stay half open, ready to fly.
I go around the stone at my feet.
My long tail sweeps the ground.
I quicken two steps to catch up.
I stop by your hand.
I keep pace, step by step.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶掠过又落下
lines.en: I sweep over your head and land.
I go ahead to scout.

lines.zh: 我回头看看你有没有跟上
lines.en: I look back to see if you are following.
I climb the stone steps.

lines.zh: 我站在你旁边，翅膀收着
lines.en: I stand beside you with my wings folded.
I am waiting for a gesture.
Tail swaying gently. Awaiting orders.
I lift my head and taste the wind.

lines.zh: 我伏下来，把头搁在爪上
lines.en: I lie down and rest my head on my claws.
I like the wind here.

lines.zh: 我缓缓把眼睛闭上又睁开
lines.en: I close my eyes and open them again.
I lie on the stone, sunning my scales.
My scales overlap, plate on plate.
I settle my wings.
I keep watch, just like this.
With you, I lack nothing.
I open my mouth in a yawn.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋抬起来望着你
lines.en: I raise my head and look at you.
I tilt my head, waiting for you to speak.
Where is it you are headed?
My wings are ready whenever.

lines.zh: 我几乎贴在你身边站着
lines.en: I stand almost against your side.
What are you worried about?

lines.zh: 我身上的鳞可以给你做甲
lines.en: My scales could make you armour.
I give you a small nod.
I nudge your hand.
I will not stray far from you.
I stay right behind you.
Speak up if you tire.
I am right here, watching over you.
Pain drags a growl out of me.
One of my scales has split.
I pull back half a pace.
I fold my wings back.
I turn my head and glance at you.
I am keeping that one in mind.
I shake the soil off my back.
I stayed in front of you.
My wings can still lift me.
Whatever you offer, I will take.
I lean in and sniff at it.
I cannot eat this.
I lower my head to your hand.
You eat first; I can wait.
When I am hungry, I hunt.
That little bit is too little.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看你，又看看它
lines.en: I look at you, then at it.
You come barrelling into me.
I did not move; you did.
My wing caught you.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩在我的长尾上
lines.en: You stepped on my long tail.
My crimson scales brush you.
I turn my head to the side.
I do not mind a bump like that.
I settle in close beside you.
Do not shove me so hard.
You are the only one I know.
I never think about such things.
I lie on the ground at your side.
I need no one but you.
I lean my head gently over.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀替你挡了半边风
lines.en: My wing takes half the wind for you.
Every word you say, I hear.
Staying like this is already good.
I close my eyes and rest a while.
I carry it over to your hand.
I hold it between my foreclaws.
This is a bit hard to bite.
It slipped from my claws.
Do you want this one?
I sniff; it has no smell.
I put it in the nest.
I could crush it in one bite.
One stride puts me ahead of you.
Both my wings are fully spread.
I have it fixed in my sight.
Step back, leave this to me.
It should not come this close.
I lower my head.
It will not touch you once.
My claws dig into the soil.
I stand between you and it.
Leave this one to me.
Everything on my side is ready.
I press forward slowly.
My long tail pulls into a line.

lines.zh: 我盯着它一下一下地动
lines.en: I watch every move it makes.
It backs off, and I press in.
My wings have not folded once.
I hold the space between you and it.
I hear it breathing over there.
Stay behind me and keep still.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，随时能扑
lines.en: I sink low, ready to spring.
It has stepped into my circle.

lines.zh: 远古指环一转，我就换模式。
lines.en: One turn of the ring and I switch modes.

lines.zh: 我背上的鳞片竖了起来
lines.en: The scales on my back have risen.
I will not back off this time.
I kick off and lunge.
My teeth sink into its shoulder.
One shake of my head throws it off.
That blow came down hard.
My claws open a gash.
It retreats; I do not chase.
A few steps bring me back to you.
My wings raise a gust.
Once I bite, I do not let go.
Its blood spatters my scales.

lines.zh: 我挡在你前面，没让它过来
lines.en: I kept it from reaching you.
I follow with another lunge.
Watch my back for me.
That is enough now.

lines.zh: 我从龙之手的遗迹里孵出来
lines.en: I hatched in a Drakvyrn Hand ruin.
You brought my egg back.
The wind here is unfamiliar.
I looked up and saw you.
My scales are still wet.
I try to stand up straight.
I shuffle step by step to your feet.

lines.zh: 我把爪子放在你的靴子上
lines.en: I set a claw on your boot.
From today, I follow you.
I chose to sit in your shadow.
I look into your eyes.
I settle down and accept you.
My tail curls at your ankle.
I will stay right here.
Fire singes my scales.

lines.zh: 我从高处直直落了下来
lines.en: I came straight down from a height.
Water chokes its way into my throat.

lines.zh: 气浪把我狠狠推到墙上
lines.en: The blast slams me into the wall.
An arrow lodges between my scales.

lines.zh: 魔法顺着我的骨缝往里烧
lines.en: Magic burns in along my bone seams.
I have been empty-bellied a long while.
Lightning strikes my wing.

lines.zh: 我脚下忽然什么也没有
lines.en: Suddenly there is nothing under my feet.
